svg.text: STACK FRAME — Hover, Click for Calling Conv (Ctrl+wheel zoom)

g.data-tooltip: High addr — caller's stack, 7th+ arg spills here
g.data-detail: Caller pushes 7th+ arg on stack before call. On SysV, 7th at [rsp+8]; on Win64, 5th at [rsp+32+8] (shadow 32B). Get it wrong = garbage.

g.data-tooltip: Return address — 8B pushed by call, popped by ret
g.data-detail: call pushes RIP (8B). ret pops it. If you sub rsp without 16B align, movaps in callee faults.

g.data-tooltip: Saved rbp — push rbp; mov rbp,rsp — frame pointer
g.data-detail: Frame pointer for debugger: push rbp; mov rbp,rsp. Callee-saved: must restore before ret.

g.data-tooltip: Locals — sub rsp,N, your vars, 16B aligned, red zone below
g.data-detail: Locals: sub rsp,16 — your ints. SysV red zone 128B below rsp usable in leaf without sub. Win64 shadow 32B above ret for callee to spill rcx/rdx/r8/r9.

g.text: Calling conv — click stack boxes left
SysV: rdi rsi rdx rcx r8 r9 + xmm0-7
Win64: rcx rdx r8 r9 + shadow 32B
Callee: rbx rbp r12-r15 — must preserve
Caller: rax rcx rdx — can clobber
Lab: clobber rbx without push → crash, fix with push/pop.

svg.text: Try: hover each stack box, click for ABI detail, Ctrl+wheel to zoom
Next: inline-asm — constraints tell compiler what's in/out.
